question: The Sangeet Natak Akademi gives fellowships to eminent artists. Sonal Mansingh received it for Odissi which is a dance form of which State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sonal Mansingh

 
 
• Indian classical dancer and Guru Bharatanatyam and Odissi dancing style.
 
• She is a teacher, researcher, choreographer, and social activist.
 
• Also Nominated by the President of India to become a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha.
 
• She is the youngest recipient of Padma Bhushan in 1992 and Padma Vibhushan in 2003.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi

 
 
• It is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• The Akademi's main objectives are to promote the development of music, dance, and drama in India.
 
• It organizes performances, training programs, and awards to encourage artists.
 
• The Akademi also maintains a vast archive of recordings and documentation of various performing arts.
 
• PV Rajamannar was the first chairman of the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• The Akademi was established in 1952 by the Indian government to promote and preserve the performing arts of India.
 
• As the first chairman, PV Rajamannar played a significant role in laying down the foundation and vision of the Akademi.
